displayName: Niche 10: Học đường / Campus / Bắt nạt và thân phận
description: Young Adult school and campus drama centered on scholarship stigma, bullying, rich clique pressure, donor-parent interference, exam-record reveal, talent-show stage reveal, anti-cheating evidence, plagiarism reversal, sports-team politics, transfer-student outsider arc, hidden identity at school, online group-chat shaming, dorm hierarchy, school-paper investigation, and disciplinary-committee reveal. chapterArcDefaults.hookStyle: public student humiliation in a school venue (cafeteria, classroom, group chat, locker room, team photo, assembly) with identity, scholarship, or merit stakes

humiliationPacing: cafeteria, classroom, locker room, or team-photo shame escalates with phone cameras
rich clique and group chat turn the school against her behind a screenshot
teacher, coach, or donor parent protects the bully or kills the complaint
talent show, exam record, or stage proof accumulates while she is told to stay quiet
she is accused of cheating, plagiarism, or theft to discredit her in front of peers
her scholarship or financial aid is publicly questioned by a peer's parent
the dorm hierarchy enforces 'who you can sit with' as a punishment
her transfer-student status is used against her in social and academic spaces
the school paper is leaned on to drop the story she filed
revengeActivation: scholarship ledger, exam metadata, or draft history clears her in the academic hearing
a bodyguard, donor truth, or family lawyer arrives only after evidence, not before
the principal must correct the public record at assembly or in the school paper
the heroine protects another bullied student first, before claiming her own dignity
the disciplinary committee hears the real tape / message log / drafts folder
the talent show, debate stage, or competition becomes the public reveal venue
the donor parent's leverage is exposed with paper, not gossip
the rich clique's group chat becomes the evidence that closes the case
the school updates its anti-bullying or scholarship policy on the record
dignityRecoveryTiming: late assembly, competition, talent show, debate finals, or disciplinary-committee public reveal — student-stage justice, not adult workplace boardroom

belongsHere: school / high school / boarding school / university / dorm / campus venues
scholarship, exam record, plagiarism, cheating accusation, talent show, sports-team politics
group chat, school paper, disciplinary committee, academic-integrity hearing as evidence venues
hidden identity at school (hidden heiress, hidden champion, hidden author) revealed on a student stage
young-adult voice and student-stage justice, not adult workplace stakes
doesNotBelongHere: adult workplace / boardroom / corporate revenge (-> Niche 8)
rich-poor courtship love story without school engine (-> Niche 1)
blood-family inheritance and custody papers (-> Niche 4)
general urban discrimination on protected attributes (-> Niche 7)
